preconditions.description: The dimensions of the garden must be within the specified range.
The number of important squares must be within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= aij <= 1000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each square must contain a valid number of flowers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in important_squares)
preconditions.description: All important squares must have valid coordinates within the garden.

postconditions.expression: sum(plan[i][j] == 'X' for i in range(n) for j in range(m)) == k
postconditions.description: Exactly k squares must be covered with concrete.

postconditions.expression: all(any(plan[x-1][y-1] == 'X' for x, y in important_squares) for x, y in important_squares)
postconditions.description: From each important square, there must be a path to any other important square using concrete-covered squares.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_dead_plants) + '\n' + '\n'.join(''.join(row) for row in plan)
postconditions.description: The output must correctly display the minimum number of dead plants and the garden plan.
